# grades-unt

> UNT grade distributions by course and instructor.

Website: https://untgrades.app

## MCP server

- Endpoint: https://untgrades.app/api/mcp
- Protocol: MCP Streamable HTTP, hosted by the Next.js app on Vercel.
- Data: deployed encrypted course and instructor data.
- Configuration: set `NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_KEY` in the Vercel project to the key used to encrypt the deployed data.

### Tools

- `search_grades`: search by course code, title, or instructor name. Input: `query`.
- `get_course_grades`: read section grades and course aggregates. Inputs: `prefix`, `number`; optional `offset` and `limit`.
- `get_instructor_courses`: list courses for an exact instructor name. Inputs: `firstName`, `lastName`; optional `offset` and `limit`.

Pagination defaults to offset `0` and limit `25`. The maximum limit is `50`.
